evidence_role: official projection method and horizon context

evidence_role: official 2023–2100 national projection series and alternative-scenario boundary

title: Census Bureau Population and Housing Unit Estimates
evidence_role: distinction between current estimates and projections
source_scope: states, counties, metropolitan areas, cities, and towns

title: NOAA Climate Change Impacts
evidence_role: climate impacts on water, energy, transportation, infrastructure, ecosystems, and human systems
use_limitations: Used for broad climate-system context only; climate migration remains an explicit high-uncertainty scenario mechanism with no migration count or causal local forecast.

title: Ohio Department of Development — Population Projections Overview: 2020 to 2050
source_scope: Ohio; statewide projection with county comparison and map

title: Michigan Center for Data and Analytics — County Population Projections through 2050

title: STATS Indiana — Population Projections Help Page

title: Phase 11B generalized mobility and system-dependency interfaces
